verdict.rationale: The product documents API and SDK coverage for the main objects the no-code UI manages. Workflows can be created, updated, run and deleted, source connectors can be created, listed, updated and deleted, and jobs can be triggered, monitored and inspected. The UI's "Get Code" option also suggests UI actions map onto API calls. No document states full UI/API parity, so the "everything" part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returned 404), API evidence for account and user administration, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Build and manage Unstructured workflows with the Python SDK or REST endpoints. Create, update, run, and delete workflows that process and transform documents from source to destination.
Track and control the processing jobs that execute your workflows. Trigger runs, monitor status, download results, and inspect any files that failed during processing.
Reference the Unstructured Platform API endpoints and settings for creating, listing, updating, and deleting workflow source connectors.
Optionally, Extract structured data and use Get Code to build an integration.
